independent_evaluator_rule: Parse retained public JSON and original raw ASGI events; do not import actor/runner/coordinator/profile modules. The unchanged generic certificate checker may check the supplied finite model, separately from source fidelity.
native_route_qualification: Independent raw native TCP/application capture and effects only.
bridge_route_qualification: Independent legal outgoing schema, actual MCP transcript, exact original card discovery/dispatch boundary, and actual original stores. No invented inverse, gateway or blanket non-support claim.
